about_the_game:
Your kamioshi's stream abruptly ends one day & his silence creates rampant rumors. Avoiding the online toxicity, you join a group chat where fans gather to discuss their beloved oshis in safety, fending off trolls together

In this otome, who's real & who's pretending in chat?


Romanceable Characters

  • Piece together the identities of 3 romanceable characters.

Game Features

  • Sift through fake surveys, sketchy stores, and sus emails in minigames that blur the line between truth and scam. Can you tell what is real?

  • Unlockable CGs

  • Unlockable Achievements

  • Multiple Endings
